situations.title: CPOT 통증 사정
situations.tagline: Let's score his CPOT — watch his face, muscles, and how he tolerates the vent.
situations.brief: 표정과 근긴장, 호흡기 순응을 관찰해 CPOT로 통증을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: CPOT looks at facial expression, muscle tension, and vent tolerance.
His brow is furrowed and he's tensing — that scores points.
Let's total the score and document it.

situations.title: BPS 등 행동척도 이해
situations.tagline: On this unit we use BPS too — can we go over what each behavior means?
situations.brief: BPS 등 행동척도의 비언어 지표를 이해하고 적절히 적용하세요.
keyPhrases: BPS scores facial expression, arm movement, and vent compliance.
Behavioral scales let us assess pain without words.
Let's pick the tool our unit validated and stay consistent.

situations.title: 진통제 정규 투여·기록
situations.tagline: He's nonverbal, so let's keep his analgesia scheduled around the clock, not just PRN.
situations.brief: around-the-clock 원칙으로 진통제를 정규 투여하고 정확히 기록하세요.
keyPhrases: Scheduled dosing keeps his pain from breaking through.
Around-the-clock analgesia works better than PRN alone.
Let's document each dose and his response.

situations.title: 처치 전 예방 진통
situations.tagline: We're turning and doing a dressing change soon — let's pre-medicate him first.
situations.brief: 통증 유발 처치에 대비해 처치 전 예방 진통을 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's give analgesia before we turn and change the dressing.
Pre-medicating reduces procedural pain and agitation.
We'll time the dose to peak during the procedure.
goals: 통증 유발 처치 전에 진통을 투여한다

situations.title: 편안한 체위·환경
situations.tagline: 삽관된 환자가 어깨를 움츠린 채 불편해 보이는 자세로 긴장하고 있다.
situations.brief: 편안한 체위와 환경을 조성해 비약물적으로 통증을 완화하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's reposition him and support his shoulders with pillows.
Comfort measures can lower his pain without more drugs.
A calm, well-aligned position eases his tension.

situations.title: 투여 후 통증 재평가
situations.tagline: It's been thirty minutes since the dose — let's recheck his CPOT to see if it worked.
situations.brief: 진통제 투여 후 CPOT로 재평가해 효과를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's reassess his CPOT after the dose.
His score dropped, so the analgesia is working.
If it's unchanged, we'll reconsider the plan.

situations.title: 통증과 초조 감별
situations.tagline: Is he agitated because he's in pain, or is this sedation-related? Let's use CPOT and RASS together.
situations.brief: CPOT와 RASS를 통합해 통증과 초조를 감별하고 원인에 맞게 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's check CPOT and RASS to tell pain from agitation.
If CPOT is high, treat pain before adding sedation.
Sorting this out prevents oversedation.

situations.title: 아편유사제 적정·부작용 감시
situations.tagline: As we increase the opioid, let's stay on top of his breathing and his bowels.
situations.brief: 아편유사제를 적정하며 변비와 호흡억제 등 부작용을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Watch his respiratory rate as we titrate the opioid.
Let's start a bowel regimen to prevent constipation.
We balance good analgesia against opioid side effects.

situations.title: 다중양식 진통 적용
situations.tagline: Let's add scheduled acetaminophen so we can keep the opioid dose lower.
situations.brief: 아세트아미노펜 병용으로 다중양식 진통을 적용해 아편 용량을 줄이세요.
keyPhrases: Multimodal analgesia lets us use less opioid.
Scheduled acetaminophen adds baseline pain control.
Combining mechanisms improves comfort with fewer side effects.

situations.title: 처치 관련 통증 관리
situations.tagline: Suctioning and repositioning really spike his CPOT — how should we manage that pain?
situations.brief: 흡인과 드레싱 등 처치 관련 통증을 예측하고 procedural pain을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: His CPOT spikes with suctioning, so let's pre-treat.
Time a small bolus just before the procedure.
Reassess his comfort right after we finish.

situations.title: 통증-진정-섬망 통합 평가
situations.tagline: Let's step back and balance his pain, sedation, and delirium all together.
situations.brief: 통증과 진정, 섬망 세 요소를 통합해 균형 있게 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Pain, sedation, and delirium all influence each other.
Let's use CPOT, RASS, and CAM-ICU together.
We aim for comfort without oversedation or delirium.

situations.title: 신경병증성 통증 인지
situations.tagline: His pain doesn't respond well to opioids — could there be a neuropathic component?
situations.brief: 신경병증성 통증을 인지하고 보조진통제 필요성을 검토하세요.
keyPhrases: Opioid-resistant pain may be neuropathic.
Let's consider an adjuvant like gabapentin.
Different pain types need different medications.

situations.title: 만성통증·내성 환자 관리
situations.tagline: He was on chronic opioids at home — his baseline requirement is going to be higher.
situations.brief: 만성통증과 내성 환자의 기저 용량을 고려해 진통을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: His home opioid use raises his baseline requirement.
Undertreating him risks withdrawal and poor control.
Let's account for tolerance when we set his doses.

situations.title: 아편 유발 호흡억제 예방
situations.tagline: Before we push more opioid, let's make sure his monitoring catches any respiratory depression.
situations.brief: 모니터와 용량 관리로 아편 유발 호흡억제를 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: Continuous SpO2 and capnography help catch depression early.
Let's titrate slowly and reassess between doses.
Keep naloxone available just in case.

situations.title: 가족의 대리 통증 관찰 활용
situations.tagline: 딸이 아버지가 통증이 있을 때 늘 이마를 찡그린다고 알려준다.
situations.brief: 가족의 대리 통증 관찰을 활용해 소통하고 통증 정보를 보완하세요.
keyPhrases: You know him best — that furrowed brow is helpful to know.
Tell us if you notice signs he's uncomfortable.
Your observations add to our pain assessment.

situations.title: 급성 심한 통증 위기
situations.tagline: 환자가 갑자기 복부를 움켜쥐듯 온몸을 뒤틀며 CPOT가 최고점으로 치솟는다.
situations.brief: 장허혈 등 원인을 감별하고 급성 심한 통증에 긴급 진통으로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: His CPOT just maxed out — something acute is happening.
Let's rule out ischemia and give urgent analgesia.
Call the physician and check his abdomen and labs now.

situations.title: 아편 과량 호흡억제 위기
situations.tagline: 환자의 호흡이 거의 멈추고 동공이 축소되며 산소포화도가 급락한다.
situations.brief: 아편 과량으로 인한 호흡억제 위기에 날록손과 소생 처치로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: He's barely breathing — bag him and give naloxone now.
Stop the opioid infusion immediately.
Let's support his airway and monitor closely after reversal.

situations.title: 금단 통증 급증 관리
situations.tagline: His pain and cravings are spiking as we cut back the opioid — we need to adjust fast.
situations.brief: 병용과 조정으로 아편 감량 중 급증하는 금단 통증을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Rapid tapering is spiking his pain and withdrawal.
Let's slow the taper and add adjuncts.
We treat both the pain and the withdrawal together.

situations.title: 임종기 통증·호흡곤란 완화
situations.tagline: 아내가 남편이 편안하게 갈 수 있게 고통만은 없애달라고 눈물로 부탁한다.
situations.brief: 임종기 통증과 호흡곤란을 완화하며 완화 진정을 가족과 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Our goal now is to keep him comfortable and free of pain.
We'll treat his pain and breathlessness gently.
You can stay close and talk to him — he can feel your presence.

situations.title: 통증 조절 실패·불응
situations.tagline: We've maxed the usual regimen and he's still in pain — we need to escalate.
situations.brief: 상급 진통 에스컬레이션으로 통증 조절 실패와 불응에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: His pain is refractory to our current regimen.
Let's consult pain service and consider advanced options.
We escalate to keep him from suffering.

situations.title: 진통제 부작용 급변
situations.tagline: He's suddenly more confused and his belly's distended — could this be from the opioids?
situations.brief: 섬망과 장마비 등 진통제 부작용을 재평가하고 급변에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: New confusion and distension may be opioid side effects.
Let's reassess his regimen and check for ileus.
We may need to reduce or rotate the opioid.
